scientific_integrity: Analytical proof for a local, fixed-speed-ratio perturbation with numerical corroboration; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fourier measurement refers to canonical angular time and is not a parametrization-free image invariant.
No uniform estimates near speed-ratio endpoints; no claim of geometric nonellipticity from a temporal harmonic alone.
Priority claims have residual risk from older unindexed pursuit theory.
title: Sharp third-harmonic susceptibility and optimal speed ratio in weakly elliptical pure pursuit
